profileEvidence.summary: Friendly and even-tempered in the breed standard, the Rabbit Wire-haired Dachshund combines a persistent hunting focus with a keen nose. It works below ground and also gives voice, flushes and tracks above it. Germany’s Teckel club has organized Dachshund breeding since 1888.
